title: Multi-Agent Review
intro: Choose a pull request and up to five enabled agents. Each reviews the same diff independently, in parallel.
estimates: Estimates use this PR’s completed historical runs; models and input changes can affect the result.
noFindings: No findings in this completed review.
grouping: Groups use the same file, overlapping lines, category and similar title tokens. Original findings remain separate and attributed.
runError: Could not start the selected review. Your selection is preserved.
versionWarning: Enabled agents only; disabled agents can be enabled in the agent editor.
